item.title: Human-to-human communication in the age of LLMs
item.description:
“I would have written a shorter letter, but did not have the time.” — Mark Twain Blaise Pascal

What does that mean? It means that to blab around is easy, but to write something complete, concise, where you treat your reader with respect and respect their time takes effort.

I had read that the best CEOs are amazing writers.

Today, in the age of AI, LLMs, ChatGPT, people have their brains on cruise control. Yes, LinkedIn is slop, but I have a lot of people writing to me like some meat proxy for ChatGPT.
